headword: {研究発表|けんきゅうはっぴょう}
reading: けんきゅうはっぴょう

definitions.explanation: A formal presentation of research findings, typically given at academic conferences, seminars, or within a university or research institution. A core activity of academic and scientific life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学会|がっかい}→学会：04139_gakkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{研究発表|けんきゅうはっぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I am giving a research presentation at next month's conference.

examples.japanese: {研究発表|けんきゅうはっぴょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{遅|おそ}く→遅い：00533_osoi⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦スライド→スライド：11582_suraido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I am making slides late every night in preparation for my research presentation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{研究発表|けんきゅうはっぴょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かり→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧やすく、⟦{質疑応答|しつぎおうとう}→質疑応答：16289_shitsugioutou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{的確|てきかく}→的確：04536_tekikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{答|こた}えていて→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{評価|ひょうか}→評価：03583_hyouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: Her research presentation was easy to follow, and she answered questions accurately during the Q&A, earning high praise.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧ (research) and ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧ (presentation, announcement). A fundamental term in academic Japanese, encountered by anyone studying or working at a university in Japan.

USAGE:
Can refer to both oral presentations (talks) and poster presentations at conferences. Also used for presentations within a research lab or seminar class. The term covers the entire process of presenting research, from the talk itself to the materials and preparation involved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {研究発表|けんきゅうはっぴょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a research presentation
- {研究発表|けんきゅうはっぴょう}{会|かい}: research presentation session
- {研究発表|けんきゅうはっぴょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{要旨|ようし}→要旨：04087_youshi⟧: abstract of a research presentation
- ⟦{口頭|こうとう}→口頭：11892_koutou⟧{研究発表|けんきゅうはっぴょう}: oral research presentation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧: presentation, announcement — the general term; ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧ specifies the academic context
- {学会発表|がっかいはっぴょう}: conference presentation — specifically at an academic conference
- ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧: academic paper, thesis — the written form of research output, as opposed to an oral presentation
- {卒業研究|そつぎょうけんきゅう}: graduation research — undergraduate thesis research, which culminates in a presentation
